context: Two friends complain about their favorite food delivery app crashing right when they try to order dinner on a Friday night.

dialogue.speaker: Wang Lei
dialogue.message: 哎呀，这个外卖软件又崩了！
dialogue.transliteration: Āiyā, zhège wàimài ruǎnjiàn yòu bēng le!

notes.崩了: Literally "collapsed"; slang for an app or server crashing.

dialogue.speaker: Li Na
dialogue.message: 我这边一直转圈圈，什么都点不了。
dialogue.transliteration: Wǒ zhèbiān yīzhí zhuànquānquān, shénme dōu diǎn bùliǎo.

notes.转圈圈: Literally "spinning in circles"; describes a loading spinner that never finishes.

dialogue.speaker: Wang Lei
dialogue.message: 周五晚上大家都在点餐，服务器都被打爆了。
dialogue.transliteration: Zhōuwǔ wǎnshang dàjiā dōu zài diǎncān, fúwùqì dōu bèi dǎbào le.

notes.打爆: Literally "hit until burst"; to overwhelm a server with traffic.

dialogue.speaker: Li Na
dialogue.message: 要不再试一次？死马当活马医吧。
dialogue.transliteration: Yàobù zài shì yí cì? Sǐmǎ dàng huómǎ yī ba.

notes.死马当活马医: Idiom: treat a dead horse as alive; try a long-shot fix because nothing else works.

dialogue.speaker: Wang Lei
dialogue.message: 好吧，不行就去楼下吃面。
dialogue.transliteration: Hǎo ba, bù xíng jiù qù lóuxià chī miàn.
